question_as_asked: Please list the product descriptions of the transactions taken place in the gas stations in the Czech Republic.

question.question_text: Please list the product descriptions of the transactions taken place in the gas stations in the Czech Republic.
question.evidence_text: Czech Republic can be represented as the Country value in the gasstations table is 'CZE';

executed_sql:
SELECT p.description 
FROM transactions_1k t 
JOIN gasstations g ON t.gasstationid = g.gasstationid 
JOIN products p ON t.productid = p.productid 
WHERE g.country = 'CZE';
